content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy primarily provides digital product sales solutions, offering an intuitive interface for creators to list and sell their products. However, it is limited by geographic restrictions, leaving creators in countries like Nigeria and Pakistan without access. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, offers a comprehensive solution by integrating free and self-hosted tools that allow creators to set up their own stores. This means that creators can operate their online stores without reliance on third-party platforms, maintaining control over their products and transactions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy, like many other platforms, limits access based on the user's geographic location, effectively locking out creators from many countries. This exclusion means that creators unable to access these platforms must seek alternatives, which often lack the same level of support and functionality. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, provides a robust workaround. By using self-hosted solutions, creators can sell their products and accept payments without the interference of geographic limitations. This approach not only empowers creators but also eliminates reliance on platforms prone to block access based on location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms often come with hidden fees and delayed payment processes, which can frustrate creators. For example, PayPal can hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal, which can severely impact cash flow. By utilizing sovereign commerce infrastructure like NOWPayments in the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can enjoy faster payment processing with a nominal fee of just 0.5%. This not only ensures quicker access to funds but also provides a clear understanding of the costs involved, allowing creators to plan their finances effectively.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures you own your online store and data.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A major drawback of platforms like Lemon Squeezy is that creators do not fully own their infrastructure or data. They are reliant on third-party services, which can change terms or even suspend accounts without warning. In contrast, with sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators retain full ownership of their online store and customer data. This architecture enables automation in payment processing and product delivery, ensuring that creators can focus on their work without being hindered by platform restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When considering which option to implement, creators in restricted countries should prioritize sovereignty and control. Choosing sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack enables them to avoid the pitfalls associated with traditional platforms. This architecture provides a comprehensive solution tailored for creators, allowing them to deploy their stores rapidly while ensuring that they are not dependent on external platforms that impose restrictions. This strategic choice empowers creators to maximize their potential without limitations.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can set up a sovereign commerce infrastructure using tools like the Edge Commerce Stack. This setup allows you to host your online store independently, accept crypto payments, and ensure prompt product delivery. By choosing this approach, you can avoid the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
